stories.title: Coaching commiseration: How Chargers' Harbaugh, Ravens' Minter aim to revive their seasons
stories.summary: Los Angeles stands at 0-8 on the season while Baltimore deals with its worst three-game stretch in team history.

stories.title: What is wrong with the Chargers' offense this season? Assessing five major factors
stories.summary: Are injuries the biggest reason behind the Chargers' offensive struggles? We looked at the tape for answers.

stories.title: Sources: Patriots fear QB Maye has broken ankle, could miss rest of season
stories.summary: The Patriots are concerned that Drake Maye sustained a fractured ankle, sources told ESPN, an injury that could sideline the star QB for the rest of the season.

stories.title: Cignetti: Narrative surrounding Indiana 'feeds into our motivation and our chip'
stories.summary: Indiana coach Curt Cignetti thinks his team's accomplishments continue to be unfairly discredited, and he's using it for motivation as the Hoosiers chase another national title.

stories.title: Arch will participate in Texas senior day, says he's not thinking about future
stories.summary: Texas quarterback Arch Manning said Monday he will participate in Saturday's senior day ceremonies despite having one year of eligibility remaining.
